about: Amherstburg is a town in Essex County, Ontario, on the Detroit River at the western tip of Lake Erie country. It preserves a fortified War of 1812 landscape at Fort Malden and a historic downtown facing the shipping channel toward Belle Isle and Detroit. Marshlands and island shores frame the southern approaches. About 24,000 people live in Amherstburg.
seoSummary: Historic Detroit River town in Essex County, home to Fort Malden and a riverfront downtown.
